CLASS_FUNCTION_CONTRACTS.PURPOSE: Зафиксировать минимальную реализационную поверхность классов, функций, публичных типов и событий, достаточную для утверждённых module contracts без преждевременных abstractions.

LAZY_IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDARY.RULE: Создать только Product3DWidget, ThreeViewer и ModelViewerArAdapter. Конфигурационная логика остаётся одной чистой функцией; дополнительные runtime-классы запрещены без изменения контракта.

Начальная runtime-реализация использует ровно четыре исходных файла: src/product-3d-widget.ts, src/configuration.ts, src/three-viewer.ts и src/ar-adapter.ts. Отдельные index.ts, types.ts, events.ts, state.ts, utils.ts и manager-файлы не создаются.

Публичные и межмодульные операции ограничены контрактами этого артефакта. Private implementation-local helper допустим без отдельного контракта только когда он не экспортируется, не владеет самостоятельным состоянием или ресурсом, не вводит новый side effect, error policy или dependency и декомпозирует ровно одну contracted operation. Иначе сначала изменяется ClassFunctionContracts.xml.
Custom Elements lifecycle, Shadow DOM, CustomEvent, Promise, ResizeObserver, Set/Map и platform user activation используются напрямую без wrapper.
Публичный stopAnimation не создаётся: утверждённые требования предусматривают завершение, replacement, scenario/AR stop и cleanup, но не отдельную host-команду остановки обычной анимации.
Известный потолок внутри конкретной реализации маркируется PONYTAIL-комментарием по утверждённому формату; общий speculative comment не создаётся.

PROJECT_PROCESS_DECISION.DECISION: Separate MentalScenarios.xml and VerificationCriteria.xml artifacts are omitted for this project by explicit human project-owner instruction.
PROJECT_PROCESS_DECISION.PRESERVED_GUARANTEES: Scenario reasoning and deterministic verification properties remain embedded in FUNCTION_CONTRACT preconditions, postconditions, failure behavior, MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK and the later executable tests; skipping separate files does not waive tests or contract verification.
PROJECT_PROCESS_DECISION.CONSEQUENCE: After human approval of this completed ClassFunctionContracts.xml, implementation and executable tests may begin directly.

IMPLEMENTATION_PARTICIPANTS.CLASS_CONTRACT: Exposes stable Shadow DOM parts and applies loading/error visibility.
Fills and resizes the viewer area from the actual host-controlled container.

HOST_ELEMENT.RULE: The host page owns the element width and any applicable explicit height through ordinary CSS.
The component behaves as a block-level content container and does not impose a fixed pixel size.
When no applicable height is supplied, the component uses the fallback aspect ratio from --product-3d-aspect-ratio.

CSS_PART.name: viewer
CSS_PART.PURPOSE: Style the complete internal 3D-viewer area, including its background and container-level presentation, without exposing the internal canvas structure.
CSS_PART.RULE: The part fills the complete available width and height of the component content area.

CSS_PART.name: loading
CSS_PART.PURPOSE: Style the loading-state surface shown during configuration and primary-model loading.
CSS_PART.RULE: The part occupies the same complete content area as viewer and is hidden when no loading state is active.

CSS_PART.name: error
CSS_PART.PURPOSE: Style the blocking-error message surface without changing the error text or state semantics.
CSS_PART.RULE: The part occupies the same complete content area as viewer and is hidden when no blocking error is active.

CSS_CUSTOM_PROPERTY.name: --product-3d-aspect-ratio
CSS_CUSTOM_PROPERTY.PURPOSE: Override only the fallback aspect ratio used when the host has not supplied an applicable height.
CSS_CUSTOM_PROPERTY.RULE: An explicit applicable host height takes precedence over the fallback ratio.
An absent custom property uses 4 / 3; invalid custom-property values follow ordinary CSS invalid-value behavior.

DEFAULT_STYLE_CONTRACT.RULE: Default presentation is minimal, functional and neutral, with no brand palette, decorative theme or product controls.
Loading and error text use host-compatible typography and currentColor-compatible presentation unless the host overrides their parts.
Internal Shadow DOM selectors, element nesting, canvas markup, spacing, colors and loading animation remain implementation details and are not public API.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: normalizeProductConfiguration
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Validate the trust boundary and return either blocking mandatory errors or one immutable normalized configuration with isolated optional-capability errors.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Input is unchanged.
Success contains deterministic readonly maps, exact defaults and computed scenario intersections.
Blocking failure contains no partially accepted normalized configuration.
Optional errors disable only the affected entity/group.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Expected invalid input is returned as data.
Unexpected programmer defects are not converted to success.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Same deeply equal input yields structurally equal result; input remains unchanged; all 14 configuration requirements have focused cases in the minimum Vitest file.

CLASS_CONTRACT.NAME: Product3DWidget
CLASS_CONTRACT.INTENT: The only public runtime class and confirmed-state owner.

CONSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT.RULE: attachShadow({ mode: 'open' }) and create only viewer/loading/error containers.
Expose the stable part tokens viewer, loading and error exactly as defined by PUBLIC_STYLING_API.
Do not load assets, register global listeners or accept a product in the constructor.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: No command bus, reducer/store, middleware, DI container or generic state-machine framework.
No separate UI controls for color, variants, animation, scenario or camera.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: connectedCallback
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Start a fresh initialization cycle when connected and a configuration has already been accepted for this instance.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The element has just become connected.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Without accepted configuration, lifecycle becomes STATE-NOT-CONFIGURED.
After non-terminal reconnect, prior selection and operations are discarded and initialization uses normalized initialSelection.
After terminal primary GLB failure, no new model load starts.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Creates the minimal Shadow DOM and owned lifecycle listeners when absent.
May invoke initializeCycle().

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Unexpected setup failure becomes a blocking error through commitAndNotify().

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Reconnect starts a new cycle with defaults, while a terminal GLB-failed instance performs no load.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: disconnectedCallback
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Synchronously prohibit new work and initiate idempotent cleanup of every owned runtime resource.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: The element has just become disconnected.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Lifecycle is STATE-DISCONNECTED.
No previous runtime selection or operation is eligible for resume.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls dispose() on viewer and AR adapter when present.
Removes owned listeners and references.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Cleanup continues best-effort across independent owned resources; a cleanup defect is diagnostic and does not recreate resources.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: After disconnect there are no owned RAF loops, listeners, hidden model-viewer elements or active operations.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: configure
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Validate and, only after mandatory validation succeeds, accept the single product assignment and initialize its primary viewer.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: No configuration has previously passed mandatory validation for this instance.
The instance has not reached terminal primary GLB failure.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: A configuration that passes mandatory validation is retained as the single product assignment.
Success reaches STATE-READY with initial defaults.
Mandatory validation rejection reaches STATE-ERROR, retains no accepted product assignment and permits a later corrected configure() attempt.
Primary GLB/WebGL failure reaches STATE-ERROR and marks the instance terminal where required.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls normalizeProductConfiguration().
Creates concrete viewer and optional AR adapter only when their approved capability is needed.
Publishes loading, ready or error snapshots.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: A call after mandatory configuration acceptance returns accepted=false with reason already-configured.
A corrected call after mandatory validation rejection is allowed because no product assignment was accepted.
Disconnected call returns accepted=false with reason disconnected.
Unexpected programmer errors may reject the Promise after owned cleanup.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: An invalid mandatory configuration starts no model load and may be corrected once; after the first accepted configuration, another configuration never changes productId or starts a load.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: getState
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Return the last confirmed deeply readonly snapshot without triggering work.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Returns the current snapshot object or an equivalent immutable snapshot.
No state changes.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Does not throw for ordinary lifecycle states.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Mutating a consumer-held prior value cannot change current component state.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: selectColor
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Apply an enabled color while preserving structural selection and any allowed running regular animation.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: On completion, only confirmed colorId changes.
During a regular animation the animation continues without restart.
During a scenario the command is rejected unchanged.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls ThreeViewer.applyColor().
Commits and publishes state plus selection event on success.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Unknown, unavailable, pre-ready or scenario-locked requests return rejected data without events.
Accepted viewer failure returns accepted=true outcome=failed and emits an operation error.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Changing color during regular animation changes only color and does not restart playback.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: selectVariant
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Apply an enabled structural variant only when current operation compatibility permits it.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: variantId identifies an enabled structural variant.
If a regular animation is active, the variant is in its explicit whitelist.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: On completion, only confirmed structural variant changes.
A compatible change during regular animation does not restart it.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls ThreeViewer.applyVariant().
Commits and publishes state plus selection event on success.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Incompatible result includes compatibleVariantIds and leaves viewer/state unchanged.
Scenario-active, pre-ready and unknown-id requests are rejected without events.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: An incompatible variant request leaves both state and scene unchanged and returns the whitelist.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: playAnimation
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Start or atomically replace a regular animation after full compatibility validation.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: animationId is enabled and compatible with selected structural variant.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success commits STATE-ANIMATION-PLAYING.
Replacement stops and resets the prior animation before starting the new one.
Natural completion returns the model to base pose with selection and camera preserved and commits STATE-READY.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls ThreeViewer.playAnimation().
Publishes replacement/completion semantics in deterministic order.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Invalid replacement request does not stop the current animation.
Scenario lock and incompatibility return rejected data.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: A valid replacement is observed as one committed change; an invalid replacement leaves the old animation running.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: startScenario
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Start, replace or restart a scenario atomically only after complete prevalidation.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Selected structural variant belongs to computed scenario intersection.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success commits STATE-SCENARIO-ACTIVE at step 0.
A valid request stops a current regular animation or scenario only after validation.
Accepted first-step failure clears scenario state and returns the model to ordinary base pose without restoring prior execution.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls ThreeViewer.startScenario().
Publishes one atomic scenario change after success or accepted failure state.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Invalid/incompatible request preserves current operation.
Accepted first-step failure returns accepted=true outcome=failed and emits error.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: An invalid replacement preserves the current scenario; an accepted first-step failure does not restore it.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success commits the decremented step index and starts that step from its beginning.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: At first step returns boundary rejection without stopping current step.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Boundary rejection leaves current step/playback unchanged.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: nextScenarioStep
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Move to and replay the next scenario step while preserving camera and selection.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success commits the incremented step index and starts that step from its beginning.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Navigation remains available during step playback and starts the target step from zero.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: stopScenario

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success clears scenario id/step and commits STATE-READY.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Stopping at any step clears scenario and preserves selection/camera.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: launchAR
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Initiate one mode-neutral AR request from a valid user activation without inferring the selected channel.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: AR is configured and currently available.
navigator.userActivation.isActive is true when the platform exposes it and model-viewer requires transient activation.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: A regular animation is stopped/reset before AR sync and is not resumed.
After successful initiation, result is accepted=true outcome='initiated' and lifecycle remains STATE-READY.
Only a later public WebXR start callback may commit STATE-AR-ACTIVE.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: May call ThreeViewer.stopAnimationAndReset('ar').
Calls ModelViewerArAdapter.syncSelection() then launch().
Publishes animation stop and any observable generic AR error in required order.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Scenario lock, unavailable AR or missing activation returns rejected data.
Observable request failure is generic and contains no mode.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Accepted external AR initiation leaves lifecycle READY and never emits launched without WebXR start.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: initializeCycle
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Run the minimum sequence normalize configuration → initialize viewer → initialize optional AR adapter for the current connection cycle.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: A raw configuration has been assigned once.
Instance is not terminal from primary GLB failure.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Exactly one cycle result is committed.
Leaf instances belong only to this cycle.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Creates concrete leaf instances.
Registers narrow callbacks.
Commits loading/ready/error states.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Cycle token prevents stale async completion from mutating a later connection cycle.
Blocking failure disposes partially created resources.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: A stale result from a disconnected cycle cannot commit state after reconnect.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: commitAndNotify
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Atomically replace the confirmed snapshot and enforce general-event → specialized-event ordering.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: next is internally validated and deeply readonly.
No leaf resource mutation remains pending for the represented outcome.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: this.state is next before any event listener runs.
product-3d-state-change is dispatched first.
The optional specialized event is dispatched second.
Caller may resolve the public Promise only after this method returns.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Updates minimal loading/error Shadow DOM.
Dispatches DOM CustomEvent with detail.state === next.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Listener exceptions do not roll back confirmed state and are not converted into command failure.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Listeners observe the new snapshot and exact general-before-specialized order.

TEST_STRATEGY.RULE: One Playwright integration surface verifies public methods, atomic snapshots, event order and reconnect cleanup.
Pure guards may be checked by Vitest only when extracted for a real reuse reason; do not create helpers solely to make tests look unit-like.

CLASS_CONTRACT.NAME: ThreeViewer
CLASS_CONTRACT.INTENT: The single concrete owner of Three.js scene, renderer, camera, controls, mixer and GPU resources.

CONSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT.SIGNATURE: constructor(container: HTMLElement, callbacks: Readonly<{ onAnimationCompleted(animationId: string): void; onScenarioStepCompleted(scenarioId: string, stepIndex: number): void; onRecoveryResult(result: ViewerRecoveryResult): void }>)
CONSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT.RULE: Receive the concrete viewer-part container and only the three narrow callbacks declared in the constructor signature.
onScenarioStepCompleted is invoked only after the final frame is held and lets the controller commit status='holding-final-frame'.
Do not create resources until initialize().

OWNED_STATE.STATE_ITEM: one renderer, scene, camera and control instance
loaded GLB root and model-bound lookup maps
current mixer/action and scenario step playback
camera snapshot used only for approved restore operations

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: No renderer abstraction, engine interface, repository or scene service.
No public DOM events or confirmed host state.
No direct import of Product3DWidget or ModelViewerArAdapter.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: initialize
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Create the single Three.js viewer, require WebGL 2, load primary GLB, validate model-bound references and render the confirmed initial selection.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Viewer is not initialized or disposed.
Container is connected to the current Shadow DOM cycle.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success has one renderer, scene, camera, controls and loaded GLB.
Returns enabled model-bound capabilities and local errors.
Failure leaves no partially active viewer.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Creates canvas/GPU resources, loads GLB and registers owned resize/context listeners.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: No WebGL 2 is blocking.
Primary GLB load/parse failure is terminal for the component instance.
Optional model reference errors disable only affected capabilities.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: GLB-only config renders; a failed load leaves no RAF/listeners/resources.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: applyColor
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Apply one validated color or restore captured base material values without changing playback/camera/variant.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success changes only intended materials.
Running animation continues at the same logical playback position.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Mutates owned Three.js materials and requests render.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Operation failure leaves or restores the prior rendered color as far as internally observable.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Applying color during playback does not recreate mixer/action or reset time.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: applyVariant
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Apply one validated structural visibility set without changing color or compatible regular playback.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success applies the complete target visibility set atomically from the viewer's perspective.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Mutates owned node visibility and requests render.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Failure does not deliberately choose another variant.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Compatible change preserves mixer/action time and color.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: playAnimation
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Start or replace one validated regular animation using an existing clip or bounded range.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: No scenario is active in controller-confirmed state.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Start preserves camera.
Replacement resets old model pose before the new start.
Natural completion resets base pose while reapplying selection and preserving camera.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Uses AnimationMixer and RAF only while needed.
Reports completion via the narrow playback callback.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: A start failure returns explicit failure after restoring ordinary base pose where possible.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Range stops at end; completion restores pose/selection/camera.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: stopAnimationAndReset
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Stop regular playback and restore ordinary base pose while preserving confirmed selection and camera.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: A regular animation may be active; otherwise the operation is idempotent.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: No regular AnimationAction remains active.
Selection/camera are preserved.
No automatic resume token is kept.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Stops mixer action, resets model pose and reapplies confirmed selection.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Failure is explicit to controller except during best-effort cleanup.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: AR reason leaves no resumable animation after later WebXR end.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: startScenario
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: After caller prevalidation, establish scenario base and play step zero while preserving camera and selection.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Scenario and model-bound step animations are enabled.
Controller has validated selected structural compatibility before stopping prior execution.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Success leaves scenario step zero active with status='playing'; its natural completion holds the final frame and reports completion through onScenarioStepCompleted.
Restart/replacement is one viewer operation.
Accepted first-step failure restores ordinary base pose and leaves no scenario execution.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Stops prior allowed execution, resets pose and starts step zero.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Never attempts to restore a replaced prior scenario after accepted start failure.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: First-step failure leaves ordinary pose and no active scenario.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: goToScenarioStep
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Stop current step and replay the adjacent validated step from its beginning.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Target step starts at its initial pose/time with status='playing'; natural completion holds its final frame before the callback.
Camera and selection are preserved.
Final frame remains after target completion.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Stops current action and starts target step.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Boundary is expected to be rejected by controller; unexpected viewer failure is explicit.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Navigation during playback starts adjacent step at zero without camera reset.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: stopScenario
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Stop any active scenario step and restore ordinary base pose with confirmed selection/camera.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: No scenario action remains active.
Ordinary base pose is rendered.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Stops mixer action, resets pose and reapplies selection.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Explicit failure except during cleanup.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Stop works at any step and preserves selection/camera.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: setCameraView
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Resolve configured GLB nodes and run one camera transition.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Exact position and target node world positions are reached.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: focusOnNodes
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.SIGNATURE: focusOnNodes(nodeNames: readonly string[], options?: CameraFocusOptions): Promise<ViewerCameraResult>
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Compute a union bound and a camera position that frames all requested nodes.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Union framing includes separated nodes and supports an empty-node world position.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: restoreCameraView
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Transition to and clear the saved restore snapshot only after successful completion.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Cancellation retains the restore snapshot; completion clears it.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: cancelCameraTransition
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Cancel one camera RAF without touching playback RAF or restore origin.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Playback continues after camera cancellation.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: resize
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Set renderer size and camera aspect from the actual container, using 4/3 only when no applicable height exists.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Renderer/camera match current container without model distortion.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Updates renderer dimensions, pixel ratio within an implementation cap, camera projection and render.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Zero-size transient layout does not dispose or corrupt the viewer.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Width-only host sizing uses --product-3d-aspect-ratio with default 4 / 3; a valid override changes the fallback and an explicit host height takes precedence.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: recoverContext
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Perform the single automatic WebGL recovery from last confirmed selection/camera.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Automatic recovery has not already been attempted.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Attempt flag is permanently set.
Success restores last confirmed state; failure disposes unusable resources and reports blocking failure.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Recreates only necessary renderer/viewer resources and reloads primary GLB.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: No second automatic attempt.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Two loss events cause at most one automatic recovery attempt.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: dispose
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Idempotently release every viewer-owned CPU, GPU, listener, observer, mixer and canvas resource.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: No active RAF/action/listener remains.
Owned resource references are cleared.
Repeated calls are safe.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Disposes geometries, materials, textures, controls and renderer; removes canvas/listeners.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Best-effort continues after one resource disposal defect.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Resource counters/listener probes reach zero after repeated dispose.

TEST_STRATEGY.RULE: Focused Vitest checks cover deterministic source/range and compatibility behavior only where no browser/GPU is required.
Playwright covers real WebGL 2 integration, resize, context loss boundary and cleanup.

CLASS_CONTRACT.NAME: ModelViewerArAdapter
CLASS_CONTRACT.INTENT: The single concrete wrapper around model-viewer public AR API.

CONSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT.SIGNATURE: constructor(hiddenHost: HTMLElement, callbacks: Readonly<{ onAvailabilityChange(available: boolean): void; onWebXRStart(): void; onWebXREnd(): void; onError(error: WidgetError): void }>)
CONSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT.RULE: Receive the owned hidden-DOM parent and only the four narrow callbacks declared in the constructor signature.
Do not accept channel-specific adapters or strategies.

NON_RESPONSIBILITIES.RULE: No WebXR/Scene Viewer/Quick Look subclass hierarchy.
No internal model-viewer symbols or Three.js scene access.
No visibility/timer heuristic for external AR lifecycle.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: initialize
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Create one hidden model-viewer, configure mode-neutral public AR inputs and observe public availability.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: One hidden model-viewer and only necessary public listeners exist.
Availability callback reports public canActivateAR changes without a selected mode.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Creates hidden DOM and assigns primary GLB plus usable optional USDZ.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Optional USDZ unusability removes that source and preserves GLB fallback.
Initialization failure disables only AR unless caused by a shared mandatory asset already handled elsewhere.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: No USDZ or unusable USDZ still leaves primary GLB configured for model-viewer fallback.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: syncSelection
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Apply the current confirmed color and structural selection only through model-viewer public supported capabilities.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Best publicly supported representation is ready before launch.
Unsupported transfer does not alter controller/viewer selection.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Updates public model-viewer properties/attributes only.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Observable sync failure is explicit and channel-neutral.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Sync never reads or mutates model-viewer internal Three.js scene.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: launch
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Call public activateAR() once from the host user activation and report only initiation or an observable generic failure.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Adapter is initialized and publicly available.
Call stack retains required transient user activation.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Fulfilled initiation contains no selected mode and no launched claim.
Only later public WebXR start/end callbacks produce lifecycle observations.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Calls modelViewer.activateAR().

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Observable rejection/error is generic.
Visibility changes and absence of error are ignored as lifecycle evidence.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Fulfilled activateAR without WebXR event produces no launched callback.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: handleArStatus
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Translate only public model-viewer WebXR status evidence into one start/end pair.

PRECONDITIONS.CONDITION: Event comes from the owned model-viewer public event surface.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: Observed WebXR start sets internal observed flag and calls onWebXRStart once.
End calls onWebXREnd once only if start was previously observed.
External modes and visibility produce no callback.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Updates one boolean and invokes narrow callbacks.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Unknown status values are ignored rather than inferred.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: End without prior start and duplicate statuses do not emit extra lifecycle callbacks.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.NAME: dispose
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.INTENT: Idempotently remove owned public listeners, hidden model-viewer and retained asset/selection references.

POSTCONDITIONS.CONDITION: No hidden element or listener remains.
Observed WebXR flag is cleared.
Repeated calls are safe.

SIDE_EFFECTS.EFFECT: Removes owned DOM/listeners.

FAILURE_BEHAVIOR.RULE: Does not try to infer, stop or interact with an external AR application.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.MINIMUM_RUNNABLE_CHECK: Repeated dispose leaves zero owned DOM/listeners.

TEST_STRATEGY.RULE: Playwright with a controlled public model-viewer seam verifies request and event translation.
Real Android/iOS devices remain required evidence for native AR channels; automated tests do not claim that evidence.

VALIDATION_EXPECTATIONS.CHECK: All four upstream artifacts are APPROVED at the referenced revisions and approval commits.

Exactly four runtime source files exist in the declared layout and no speculative source file is required.
Public API contains exactly the ten listed methods; no public stopAnimation or mode-specific AR method exists.
Class-level module requirement sets plus the configuration function reproduce all 86 functional requirements exactly once by architectural owner.
Every method requirement is a functional requirement and may link cross-module behavior only where the method orchestrates the approved leaf operation; class-level ownership remains exact.
